notes.title: Swarmlake 3.0 Out Now
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31953633/cf74e60808f1e4198ef37d2f7f04bccc0c1b531b.png

Hi, the free Swarmlake 3.0 Update is out now:


Added player health
Improves understandability of game overs which was by far the most common complaint since release. In the past the binary nature of one-hit deaths resulted in frustrations as there was no warning possible. Also increases the elasticity of the game challenge. This will affect the gameplay dynamic as it is now possible to intentionally take damage to get to a bomb.
Added bowl-shaped arena wall
Removes the punishing nature of falling off the arena while keeping effectively the same playspace as the recently introduced arena limit. As a reminder having a limited arena reduces the amount of invalid options such as running infinitely backwards/forwards or making too big of circles. Since the game gets harder over time this only ever resulted in slower and more frustrating deaths which were not obvious to understand. It also increases the required decision making and adds more positioning and meaning to space. So overall this improves the depth tree for both beginner and expert players.
Added wall jump
Added bomb detonation healing a fraction of health
Added health bar display
Added player damage audiovisual feedback
Added player top percent display to leaderboard
Added leaderboard rank display
Added settings tab to hide individual HUD elements
Improved enemy jump sign display
Improved shard despawn warning feedback clarity by increasing flicker speed over time
Improved sound effects mix clarity
Improved milestone score visual effect
Improved startup speed
Fixed startup delay if loading showcase failed
Reset leaderboard and settings
Decreased fire rate by 10%
Better fits expectations of when taking damage relative to enemy density. Also increases decision making by having to avoid enemies more and adapting to their patterns. This changes game feel so it might take some time to get used to it.
Increased bomb spawn height variation by 20%
Encourages more vertical play and reduces repetitive single jump strategies.
Increased enemy spawn scaling by 25%
Speeds up pacing and balances out the increased survivability of the player due to adding health.

Unfortunately the leaderboard also had to be reset.

Swarmlake has continuously evolved over time with the goal to make it more fun for more players by always keeping player feedback in mind. I am aware that people dislike change and I am sorry for the frustration this can cause.

Thank you
- Dominique

notes.title: Swarmlake 2.14
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31953633/0474692530981e1d0c61811ca874fc83cfbe9a3e.jpg

Hey all, Swarmlake 2.14 is out to improve understandability and depth:


Added arena limit
Increases the required decision making and adds more positioning and meaning to space. It improves the depth tree for both expert and beginner players. For the latter it reduces the amount of invalid options such as running infinitely backwards/forwards or making too big of circles. Since the game gets harder over time this only ever resulted in slower and more frustrating deaths which were not obvious to understand.
Improved enemy spawning to be independent of player look direction
Less punishment and more freedom of where players look. While this increases uncertainty of where enemies spawn there is still no randomness as it is the same sequence for everyone. Especially players now need to adapt more to reach bomb enemies which makes the game more dynamic.
Improved avoider (orange) enemy projectile avoidance to be a bigger threat
Makes this enemy more noticeable and reduces situations where player vision is completely blocked by enemies.
Improved bomb min move height (now can trigger without jumping if pulled down)
Increases discoverability of detonating bombs. If a bomb is not hit by a projectile and therefore possibly pulled down they still require jumping to detonate.
Fixed jumping off of bombs
Fixed showing wrong leaderboard avatar in rare cases
Removed replacing bombs on spawn limit (now pauses spawning at limit)
Encourages more dynamic player movement patterns. In the past players could ignore existing bombs and move in an infinite circle as the farthest bombs would despawn and new ones would keep spawning in front of them.
Removed score-based fire-rate (now always at max rate)
Increases death consistency as it is tightly linked to fire-rate. This also makes the early game easier.
Removed doubled enemy spawn scaling after 10,000 score (now as before 10k)
Reset leaderboard

Please keep in mind that the max highscores will be lower now due to the gameplay changes. Unfortunately the leaderboard also had to be reset.

Congratulations to the top ten players and everyone else who competed the past year:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31953633/7f7be64b2beef22ed8ed5d2f76cf99380a22cf80.jpg

Swarmlake has continuously evolved over time with the goal to make it more fun for more players. I am aware that people dislike change and I am sorry for the frustration this can cause.

Thank you
- Dominique

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31953633/6c2c18ce2e563a2c706f467ee2104952fea1c5de.jpg

Hey all, Swarmlake 2.9 is out aiming to improve the game based on recent feedback:


Decreased distance of replacing bomb on spawn limit when far away from player by 40%
Decreased time-based enemy spawn scaling by 20% (same as before 2.8)
[strike]Readded score-based bomb spawn limit[/strike] (reverted)
Fixed replacing farthest bomb on spawn limit in rare cases
Removed replacing invisible bomb on spawn limit
Reset leaderboard


Touching bombs is one of the core tensions of the game. Interesting decisions emerge from moving towards bombs (reward) while judging (uncertainty) how to best avoid enemies (cost).

Having bombs move to the player undermines this dynamic as it was better to move in an endless circle and ignore bombs until they were close. Players wanting to win were forced to play this way which reduced depth. Therefore bomb movement was removed in the recent updates.

However this increased uncertainty due to the increased time to reach bombs. This update aims to address this.

Unfortunately the leaderboard also had to be reset.

Thank you for your understanding, feedback and support
- Dominique

notes.title: Swarmlake Update 18
notes.content:
Why burst jumping was replaced with a normal jump:Burst jumping is either exploitable or unusable due to looking away which requires enemy pushback to make usable. See: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P91YPnAaeTg
Burst jumping causes deaths which are perceived as random since you need to look away
Burst jumping is difficult for the sake of it (look down+shoot+look up instead of just jumping)
Burst jumping is hard to learn, hard to master (instead of easy to learn, hard to master)
Burst shooting has zero usage outside burst jumping


You now jump off the ground and enemies directly below you using [SPACE] key. I understand that this makes the game feel different and may require some time to get used to if you played it before.

The identity of Swarmlake is to fight a swarm of billions of enemies and the challenge should come from learning how to move through massive amount of enemies while triggering bombs and collecting points and NOT from difficult controls.

Update 18 changelog:Replaced burst jump/shooting with normal jump
Increased bomb explosion radius by 14%

notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/88y8nAO.jpg

Hi all, Swarmlake Update 8 is out now with the following changes:

Added full controller support
Improved CPU performance noticably
Improved window/input handling
Fixed some dropped shards being invisible after restart
Fixed UI layout sharpness and overlap issues at certain resolutions
Fixed fullscreen performance issues
Fixed resetting resolution when resetting to defaults in fullscreen mode
Fixed field of view settings slider keyboard editing


Fast-paced first-person shooters like Swarmlake play best with keyboard and mouse however controller support is still great for casual couch play.

Thank you
Dominique

notes.title: Swarmlake Update 7
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/gnFuWoF.jpg

Hey all, Update 7 has just been released to improve Swarmlake based on new player feedback:

Increased visual-only projectile size
Increased visual-only charger enemy size
Improved perceived death fairness by slightly offsetting player collision point forward
Fixed updating displayed score in same frame as bomb explosion
Fixed crash when resizing window to zero size
Fixed camera clipping into floor on death in rare cases
Fixed issues when loading invalid settings


Thank you for your support
Dominique

notes.title: Swarmlake Update 6
notes.content:

Hi all,

Swarmlake Update 6 is now live which improves Swarmlake's accessibility and playability:

Decreased burst projectile count and cooldown by 40%
Decreased burst spread by 20%
Decreased enemy spawn amount until score of 100 greatly
Added increasing burst spam spread
Added max bomb enemy height to limit it to player reachable area
Added visual highscore upload progress indicator
Added sun scale to music-visualization
Improved teaching bomb enemy
Improved bomb enemy visibility for colorblind people
Fixed incorrect burst delay
Fixed rare highscore upload issues
Tweaked achievement score requirement curve in the middle
Tweaked burst and reflect sound effects volume
Tweaked floor color
Tweaked settings labels
Tweaked killer visual
Tweaked initial spawned wave
Removed target highscore display during gameplay


Thank you
Dominique

notes.title: Update 3
notes.content:

Fixed playing without audio if audio device fails
Fixed unintended strategies to gain massive highscores
Fixed issue when clicking resume button and pressing ESC in the same frame
Fixed issue when pausing and dying in the same frame
Increased shard despawn time by 40%
Increased theoretical enemy limit to 20,000
Decreased reflecter enemy turn speed by 50%
Decreased shard collect radius by 50%
Decreased shard floor bounciness by 30%


If you enjoyed Swarmlake please leave a brief Steam review for it if you can, as this helps a lot to make others notice my games.

Thank you
Dominique

notes.title: Update 2
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/RGbUan6.jpg

Hey all,

a new update has just gone live to improve the balance and feel of Swarmlake:

Added death sound effect variation
Added explosion sound effect ducking
Removed enemy split behavior
Increased reflecter enemy explosion radius by 10%
Increased enemy turn speed by 50%
Increased enemy spawn amount by 100%
Increased burst jump radius by 33%
Decreased burst jump max height by 25%
Decreased shard despawn time by 40%

Aggressive playstyles should now be more encouraged, dying less frustrating and the gun feel more powerful especially due to removing the enemy split behavior.

Thank you for your continued feedback
Dominique

notes.title: Translation + Update 1
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/fFYnk1R.jpg

Hi everyone,

I am very humbled about your positive reception of Swarmlake and would really like to thank you for your support and feedback. Thanks to discussions, videos and emails by the community I already made changes this first week to improve the experience which you can find listed at the bottom.

Translation
Since there are a lot of players from non-English speaking countries it would be awesome if those native speakers could help translate the store page to make sure that your country is well represented and future players know what they are getting into before trying Swarmlake. 

If you would be so kind to help translate those 7 sentences please go to the following spreadsheet and simply add the missing or fix the existing translations: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/16DnSmU8VYAGx40qS1fDtI_70Rc_v8pUlqFt21XEGuQA/edit?usp=sharing

Update 1

Added high-performance GPU detection on hybrid Laptops
Improved teaching the game at start of each round
Improved highscore upload network failure handling
Improved audio latency
Improved unlocking achievements
Improved performance slightly
Improved startup speed slightly
Improved UI navigation by setting mouse over first shown button
Improved error messages on outdated hardware
Fixed various unintended strategies to gain massive highscores
Fixed loading sensitivity between sessions
Fixed background visuals with disabled music
Fixed resolution settings handling in rare cases
Fixed footstep sounds after restart

Thank you!
Dominique
